description: This file is a PHP class named SessionSubscriber, which subscribes to HTTP request events in a Symfony-based application. It manages user sessions, invalidating them if they have been idle for longer than the configured maximum session idle time.

classes.name: SessionSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to Symfony request events to manage user sessions, invalidating them when they exceed the maximum allowed idle time.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the KernelRequest event with a high priority.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event by retrieving the session, checking its last activity time, and invalidating it if idle time exceeds the configured maximum.
